lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn4Pb4O12 (reduced formula ZnPbO3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Pb centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Zn centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. O centers have two geometric neighbors, one Pb and one Zn. Corner-sharing between Pb octahedra and face-sharing between Pb octahedra and Zn 12-vertex polyhedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
